fmiModelDescription.description: ADAS radar/camera reference controller, profile sil.adas-reference.radar-camera version 3. A reference acceptance artifact for SiL's FMI importer, not a supplier FMU or a vehicle function.

Category.name: logStatusError
Category.description: a rejected call and its cause

Float64.name: hazard_acceleration_mps2
Float64.description: target acceleration for HAZARD and SENSOR_UNAVAILABLE; finite, in [-10, 0)

Float64.name: max_change_mps2
Float64.description: most the commanded acceleration changes per step; finite, in (0, 10]

UInt64.name: radar.sample_time_ns
UInt64.description: ns of Virtual time the list describes; the start value means no list yet

UInt32.name: radar.sequence
UInt32.description: the sensor's message counter; the start value means no list yet

Int32.name: radar.object_id
Int32.description: active IDs >= 0, unique in the list

Float32.name: radar.x_m
Float32.description: longitudinal position in the ego frame, forward

Float32.name: radar.y_m
Float32.description: lateral position in the ego frame, left

Float32.name: radar.relative_vx_mps
Float32.description: longitudinal speed relative to the ego, negative when closing; 0 for the camera

UInt64.name: camera.sample_time_ns
UInt64.description: ns of Virtual time the list describes; the start value means no list yet

UInt32.name: camera.sequence
UInt32.description: the sensor's message counter; the start value means no list yet

Int32.name: camera.object_id
Int32.description: active IDs >= 0, unique in the list

Float32.name: camera.x_m
Float32.description: longitudinal position in the ego frame, forward

Float32.name: camera.y_m
Float32.description: lateral position in the ego frame, left

Float32.name: camera.relative_vx_mps
Float32.description: longitudinal speed relative to the ego, negative when closing; 0 for the camera

UInt64.name: ego.sample_time_ns
UInt64.description: ns of Virtual time the ego motion describes; the start value means none yet

UInt32.name: ego.sequence
UInt32.description: the ego motion's message counter; the start value means none yet

UInt64.name: command.sample_time_ns
UInt64.description: t + 10 ms in ns, the end of the step

UInt32.name: command.sequence
UInt32.description: steps completed, from 1; 0 before the first step

Int32.name: command.selected_object_id
Int32.description: the selected radar object's ID, or -1 for none

Float32.name: command.target_acceleration_mps2
Float32.description: the acceleration the mode asks for

Int64.name: command.radar_age_ns
Int64.description: ns since the held radar list's Sample time, or -1

Int64.name: command.camera_age_ns
Int64.description: ns since the held camera list's Sample time, or -1

Int64.name: command.ego_age_ns
Int64.description: ns since the held ego motion's Sample time, or -1

UInt32.name: command.ignored_observations
UInt32.description: observations ignored for their sequence since the start
